WITH salary_formats AS (
    SELECT CompanyName,
           Salary,
           REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(SUBSTR(Salary, 1, INSTR(Salary, '/') - 1), '₹', ''), '$', ''), ',', '') AS amount
    FROM main.SalaryDataset
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_rows,
       SUM(CASE WHEN amount <> '' AND amount NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS digit_only_amounts,
       SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(Salary, 1, 1) = '$' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dollar_rows,
       SUM(CASE WHEN CompanyName IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS null_companies,
       SUM(CASE WHEN TRIM(CompanyName) = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS blank_companies,
       MIN(CASE WHEN amount = '' OR amount GLOB '*[^0-9]*' THEN Salary END) AS example_other_format
FROM salary_formats

WITH RECURSIVE salary_characters (location, company_name, remaining_text, digits) AS (
    SELECT Location, CompanyName, Salary, ''
    FROM main.SalaryDataset
    WHERE Salary IS NOT NULL

    UNION ALL

    SELECT location,
           company_name,
           SUBSTR(remaining_text, 2),
           digits || CASE
               WHEN SUBSTR(remaining_text, 1, 1) GLOB '[0-9]'
               THEN SUBSTR(remaining_text, 1, 1)
               ELSE ''
           END
    FROM salary_characters
    WHERE remaining_text <> ''
),
cleaned_salaries AS (
    SELECT location, company_name, CAST(digits AS REAL) AS salary_amount
    FROM salary_characters
    WHERE remaining_text = '' AND digits <> ''
),
country_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(salary_amount) AS average_salary
    FROM cleaned_salaries
),
company_location_averages AS (
    SELECT location, company_name, AVG(salary_amount) AS average_salary
    FROM cleaned_salaries
    WHERE location IN ('Mumbai', 'Pune', 'New Delhi', 'Hyderabad')
      AND company_name IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY location, company_name
),
ranked_companies AS (
    SELECT location,
           company_name,
           average_salary,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY location
               ORDER BY average_salary DESC, company_name
           ) AS location_rank
    FROM company_location_averages
)
SELECT r.location AS "Location",
       r.company_name AS "Company Name",
       r.average_salary AS "Average Salary in State",
       c.average_salary AS "Average Salary in Country"
FROM ranked_companies AS r
CROSS JOIN country_average AS c
WHERE r.location_rank <= 5
ORDER BY r.location, r.location_rank
LIMIT 20
